body: DRAFT REDLINE READY, not a candidate: the reserved court now publishes separate CanonicalExternalVideoRecallTarget, OwnerAuthorizedLocalOnly, ExcludedFromGit, and IntakeUnvalidated axes. It removes new consent/REB/licence/redistribution determinations as local-analysis gates; records Chen 2017, the public ContextLab release, and Zenodo v1.3 as the published study/source family; keeps raw bytes under /tmp/ with no Git/upload/redistribution/remote processing; and retains scientific byte/edition binding, annotation and recall transforms, 17-source alias mapping, typed clocks, diagnostic-only coder semantics, frozen/cross-fitted comparison, coverage, refusal, and anti-circularity. The old rights-based candidate is abandoned. Chief questions: may this court record the local-use and raw-exclusion gates Passed while the scientific gates remain Open; does ADR 0007 Stage B require an immediate chief amendment or a successor bead; and should the successor retain the same two reviewers? No candidate, B0-close, C1-unlock, or landing claim.
